set.body: Close Z6 with evidence that the kernel can become scala-zarr without redesign. Compile minimal JVM and Scala.js consumer programs against only the zarr artifact; audit the public surface and dependency graph; run Python differential fixtures for builtin direct and sharded read/write paths, corruption, and missing-capability errors. Evaluate candidate Zstandard or Blosc providers against explicit JVM, Scala.js, size, licensing, deployment, and oracle gates, recording Go or NoGo without adding a heavy codec to core. Gate: both platform suites and repository testAll are warning-clean, standalone consumers pass, Python cross-reads pass, and the admission record names the next action.
set.title: Zarr Z6.4: standalone rehearsal and fast-codec admission record
